name: The Canon
shape: four singers in a staggered row, one per voice, faint
ambient: candlelight breathing on the stone, once every two bars

rules.what: the singers' mouths open one after another, a ripple down the row
all four lit together, then the candle steadies

name: The Imp
shape: the imp's horns and tail peeking from behind the strip's edge
ambient: a tail flick, once every four bars, slow

rules.what: the imp peeks out on the side of the voice that enters (left strip low voices, right high)
the minor turns major: the imp grins and vanishes in a puff

name: The Stone-Skipper
shape: a pond's surface across both strips, a red hood at the left strip's foot
ambient: the water's surface moving very slowly

rules.what: a stone skips: rings spread from a point that rises with the entry's pitch
the proud close: one long last skip across both strips

name: The Cross
shape: a cross on a hill, five candles at its foot
ambient: the candle flames, luminance only, ±3%

rules.what: at each new subject's section the hill lightens a step
a candle lights for each voice's first entry (five)
all five candles and a faint dawn behind the cross

name: The Coronation
shape: banners hanging from the strips' tops, a crown at the right strip's top
ambient: the banners swing with the dotted rhythm, one swing a bar

rules.what: the crown descends a step and is set

name: The Ambush
shape: tree trunks down both strips, a road between
ambient: leaves stirring at the strips' tops, one stir a bar

rules.what: a figure appears between two trunks at the entry's height, then fades back after the entry
the road empties; the trees are still

name: The Bicycle
shape: a winding lane up the left strip, a bicycle bell at the right
ambient: the lane's hedges pass slowly downward, one hedge a bar

rules.what: the bicycle's wheel turns a quarter

rules.note: no inner perfect cadence here (or no stretto by the box's rule): at its other cadences instead

name: The Pilgrim
shape: a long road climbing both strips, waymarks along it, a shrine far up
ambient: dusk deepening very slowly over the whole piece

rules.what: the pilgrim rests: the waymark lights
the shrine's light comes on at the road's top

name: The Sparrow
shape: a fence rail across both strips, a sparrow on it
ambient: the sparrow's head turns, once every two bars

rules.what: the call (the first notes): the sparrow lifts its head; the run: it hops along the rail
it flies off the strip's top

name: The Horsemen
shape: two riders, one high on the right strip, one low on the left
ambient: the riders' gallop, one stride a bar

rules.what: the rider on the entering voice's side surges ahead

rules.note: no stretto by the box's rule here: at each change of key instead

name: The Shepherdess
shape: a meadow with a crook and a lamb on the left strip
ambient: grass waving, one wave a bar of 3/8 (slowly)

name: The Requiem
shape: a row of candles along both strips' feet, a bier's outline
ambient: the candles' light, luminance only, ±3%, slower than once a second

rules.what: a candle lights (ten entries, ten candles)
between entries (episodes, calm) the light warms a little

name: The Aquarium
shape: a big glass tank across both strips, a child's face at the right strip's foot
ambient: fish drifting slowly across the strips, one crossing every few bars

rules.what: a fish turns toward the child
the fish rest; the child's hand on the glass

name: Pierrot
shape: a night window frame across the strips, a moon
ambient: the moon's light, slow

rules.what: a tear forms at the countersubject's entries (where marked) and falls

name: The Pinball
shape: pinball bumpers down both strips
ambient: bumpers' glow pulsing very slowly, one pulse a bar

rules.what: the closing pedal: all bumpers lit, a slow sweep

name: The Knight
shape: a chessboard's squares along both strips, a knight piece
ambient: none (still)

rules.what: the knight moves its L, one square a beat
the stretto zones: the knight jumps twice

name: The Diary
shape: a window with summer light on the left strip, a diary and a pressed flower on the right
ambient: the light moving across the strip over the whole piece, like an afternoon

rules.what: a line of writing appears in the diary

name: The Sleepwalker
shape: a roof ridge across both strips, the moon
ambient: clouds drifting past the moon, slowly

rules.what: the sleepwalker takes a step along the ridge
the sleepwalker reaches the chimney and sits

name: The Three Stooges
shape: a silent-film frame on both strips, three figures (generic, not portraits)
ambient: film flicker, luminance only, never faster than 1 Hz

rules.what: each voice's first entry brings on its comedian
a pratfall: one tumbles, two catch him
rules.note: no stretto by the box's rule here: at each change of key instead

rules.what: an intertitle card fades in and out (no text, just a frame)

name: The Locomotive
shape: driving wheels and a connecting rod on both strips, smoke at the top
ambient: the wheels turn with the bar, the rod with them

rules.what: the wheels turn faster for a bar
the closing pedal: the brakes, the wheels slow over its length, steam settles

name: The Marionettes
shape: a puppet stage's curtains framing both strips, three marionettes on strings
ambient: the strings sway, one sway a bar of 3/4

rules.note: no inner perfect cadence here (or no stretto by the box's rule): at its other cadences instead

name: The Procession
shape: five hooded figures with lanterns on a road, a church door far up the right strip
ambient: the lanterns sway, one sway every two bars

rules.what: each voice's first entry lights its lantern
the church door opens, light spilling

name: The Gramophone
shape: a gramophone horn on the left strip, a sleeping cat on the right
ambient: the record turning, one turn every two bars

name: Faust
shape: a scholar's study: a book on the left strip, a glowing sign in the air on the right
ambient: candle and the sign's glow, slow

rules.what: the sign gains a stroke (19 entries, the sign completes itself)
the sign fades; the book closes

name: The Olympian
shape: a stadium's columns and a podium; the athlete (a woman or androgynous)
ambient: a laurel's leaves stirring, slow

rules.what: a ring of the stadium lights

name: The Shadows
shape: figures walking at sunset, their long shadows across both strips
ambient: the sun lowering over the piece

name: The Switchboard
shape: a switchboard's sockets down both strips
ambient: a few lamps blinking very slowly

rules.what: a cord plugs into a socket at the entry's height
all lines connected, the board lit

name: The Perpetual Motion Machine
shape: a big wheel with swinging weights spanning both strips
ambient: the wheel turns all through the piece, one turn every four bars, and never stops

rules.what: the music ends; the wheel is still turning

name: The Bell Tower
shape: four bells in a tower spanning both strips
ambient: none (still)

rules.what: a bell swings, the voice's own (four voices, four bells)
the final stretto: all four swing

name: The Catapult
shape: a catapult's arm on the left strip, a castle wall on the right
ambient: none (taut)

rules.what: released: a stone arcs across the top

name: The Organist
shape: organ pipes rising up both strips
ambient: the pipes' gilt catching light slowly

name: The Rain
shape: rain on a dark street, one lit window
ambient: rain falling, slow streaks

rules.what: the subject's repeated notes: drops on the sill
the rain stops; the street shines

name: The Chorale
shape: a congregation in pews, hymn books open
ambient: window light moving slowly

rules.what: a line of the hymn book lights (34 entries)

name: The Crook
shape: a crowded fair at night, lanterns; a pickpocket in a long coat
ambient: lanterns swaying

rules.what: the crook moves a step through the crowd
the crook is gone; one purse lies on the ground

name: The Butterfly
shape: a meadow, a butterfly
ambient: the butterfly's flight path, slow

rules.what: the butterfly alights on a flower
it flies out of the strip's top

name: The Masquerade
shape: a candlelit hall, cloaked masked figures (Eyes Wide Shut-like)
ambient: candlelight; a slow procession of masks across the strips

name: The Telephone
shape: a rotary telephone on a table
ambient: none (waiting)

rules.what: the trill at each entry's head: the bell shakes

name: The Three Sisters
shape: three sisters of three ages under one tree
ambient: the tree's leaves stirring

rules.what: each subject's section brings on its sister
when the subjects combine, the sisters join hands
all three under the tree, lit

fx: PULSE · EMBERS · RIPPLE (Keller's three characters) kept

name: Hopscotch
shape: chalk squares up both strips, a girl
ambient: chalk dust drifting slowly

name: The Jury
shape: a jury box, the forewoman standing
ambient: none (tense)

rules.what: the subject's four repeated notes: the gavel's outline falls each time

rules.note: no inner perfect cadence here (or no stretto by the box's rule): at its other cadences instead

rules.what: the verdict: silence, the forewoman sits

name: The Mirror
shape: a mirror's frame across both strips, the figure on the left, her reflection on the right
ambient: candlelight in the glass

rules.what: the figure and her reflection move together (on the entering voice's side)
the half's cadence: the two halves light alike
the reflection steps forward to meet her

name: The Gigue
shape: a tavern floor, a fiddler on a barrel, a couple dancing
ambient: the fiddler's bow, one stroke a bar of 6/8

rules.what: the second theme's section brings on the second dancer
both themes together: the couple spins

name: The Wanderer
shape: a path under trees
ambient: the path passing slowly

rules.what: the wanderer stops at a view

name: The Earthquake
shape: a city street with a lamp-post
ambient: none (still, then)

rules.note: no inner perfect cadence here (or no stretto by the box's rule): at its other cadences instead

name: The Cradle
shape: a cradle by a fire, a parent's hand (mother or father)
ambient: the cradle rocks once a bar

rules.what: the fire flickers up a little

name: The Colossus
shape: a giant statue spanning both strips, ships at its feet
ambient: sea swell at the strips' feet

name: The Elegy
shape: a willow over a grave, a poet reading
ambient: the willow's branches swaying slowly

rules.what: the second theme's section: the poet turns a page

name: The Last Dance
shape: an emptying ballroom, two dancers, candles
ambient: the candles lowering over the whole piece

rules.note: no inner perfect cadence here (or no stretto by the box's rule): at its other cadences instead

rules.what: one candle left; the curtain of the whole collection
